On Elemental, Barrier, or Guardian Shield Break, applies Kinetic Damage Vulnerability to the enemy, increasing Kinetic damage taken by 50% for 5 seconds.

Does not affect <stasis Stasis /> or <strand Strand /> damage.

Stacks with all other buffs and debuffs, including itself. Each stack has its own duration and stacks multiplicatively.

source.text:
On Elemental, Barrier or Guardian Shield Break:
Inflicts Kinetic Damage Vulnerability on the enemy, increasing Kinetic Damage Taken by 50% for 5 seconds. Does not affect Stasis or Strand Damage.
Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself).
 Can be applied multiple times on a single enemy, with each stack having its own duration and stacking multiplicatively.
